frontier.note: Frontier achieved (miso-82, owner-directed): the ledgered {C3a-2025, C3c} scarcity tail is at the model's representation frontier, now externally validated. Every named admissible mechanism for the C3c tail has been tried on record and adopted per rule #1 — reserve deliverability / 10-min ramp caps (miso-39), Midwest sub-regional reserves (miso-71), measured reserve requirements (miso-56) — and none moves the >$200 tail (model 0/6/0 vs actual RT 30/37/88). ROOT CAUSE, now primary-sourced: MISO's real scarcity tail is not an emergent marginal-cost outcome even in MISO's own SCED — it is an administrative stepped ORDC/RCPF curve DERIVED FROM a Monte-Carlo LOLP simulation over net-load/outage uncertainty in a 10-30 min window (MISO Scarcity Pricing White Paper Mar-2024 §3.2.1). It prices probabilistic short-term risk a deterministic perfect-foresight hourly LP does not contain; the generic PCM literature confirms deterministic LPs systematically under-produce the spike tail (23/23-model survey arXiv 2101.02303; PyPSA-Eur arXiv 2606.16486). Empirical confirmation on THIS keeper: in the 88 actual 2025 Indiana-Hub RT>$200 hours the model prices ~$50 median / $157 max, reserve adder fires 2/88, energy+reserve>$200 in 1/88, zero load-shed; the actual DA in those hours is mostly low ($99 at RT $1,598) = forecast-error transients out of representation. Layering an ORDC/RCPF adder would fire ~2 hours, not 88; reaching the tail would require manufacturing the uncertainty (rule #1/#10 forbid the fitted path). Further C3c work needs a NEW admissible measured identification, its own charter. CAVEAT LEDGERING REALIZED 2026-07-20 (owner-directed): the {C3a-2025, C3c} family is now entered in the keeper's calibration_attestation.json exceptions ledger (price_tail 2023/2024/2025 + price_mean 2025, 2 of 3 ledgered-caveat budget), classified as documented representation-frontier MODEL MISSes — the honest opposite of a residual-fit (rules #1/#10 forbid closing them by an offer/level adder). Determination is therefore CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS and, with the live frontier designation, displays on the Calibration Status page as the clean 'FRONTIER · CALIBRATED' headline with the two caveats documented in the frontier note + criteria table (mirrors the NEISO C3c ledger precedent). This is the TRAIN-tier (2023-2025) determination plus the frontier designation — NOT the calibration-complete marker (owner declined the holdout ladder this session; frontier ≠ calibration-complete, the locked test is untouched). See docs/multi-iso/miso-scarcity-tail-external-validation-2026-07.md + docs/multi-iso/miso-scarcity-tail-diagnosis.md; miso-82 calibration-log entry.
